### His Divine Power
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/his-divine-power
Passage: 2 Peter 1:3-4
Points:
- Peter emphasizes true godliness as the primary mark separating genuine believers from corrupt teachers.
- Christ supplies believers with every spiritual resource needed to resist temptation and pursue holiness.
- Knowing Christ involves an intimate, saving relationship rather than mere intellectual facts.
- Partaking in the divine nature means reflecting God's communicable moral attributes while humbly remembering our creaturely status.

### The Power of Knowledge
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/the-power-of-knowledge
Passage: 2 Peter 1:3
Points:
- God channels His supernatural power for life and holiness directly through knowing Him.
- While knowledge does not guarantee obedience, ignorance inevitably breeds ungodliness.
- Believers must prioritize reading rich doctrinal teaching rather than shallow theological material.
- Christians should take time to thoughtfully ponder Scripture and discuss biblical truth with others.

### Equipped for Today: What "Life and Godliness" Really Means
Author: Hannah Benson
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/equipped-for-today-what-life-and-godliness-really-means.html
Passage: 2 Peter 1:3
Points:
- Dwelling on uncertain circumstances allows fear and anxiety to drown out faith.
- God's provision covers both spiritual needs for godliness and practical daily necessities for life.
- Remembering God's past faithfulness and expressing gratitude eases anxious thoughts.
- God often meets our needs in timely ways through ordinary acts of service from fellow believers.

### In the Flow
Author: Lysa TerKeurst
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-september-29-2011.html
Passage: 2 Peter 1:3
Points:
- Trying to navigate life's challenges in self-reliance is exhausting, like hiking uphill against gravity.
- God has already granted everything required for godliness through the knowledge of Christ.
- Intentional obedience positions Christians to move in harmony with the flow of God's power.
- Relying on God's divine nature replaces frustration and insecurity with His supernatural enablement.
